name: 2024 Passive + REE-way redispatch, rules, passive hold
note: As 2024 Active + REE-way redispatch (rules), with Passive trading: no re-trading after the day-ahead (ID2, ID3 and CID hold the previous schedule and repeat its price; every forecast change goes to balancing). Rerun 15 Nov with the hold carry-over fix (f981d3a: a held stage carries phase I units into the next day). Branch passive-hold-carryover f8d64a0, 366 days, weeks in order.

info.commit_message: da.jl: a battery in a frozen hour keeps its charge/discharge legs, so the next gate follows the previous charge path
